+            f"{note}: rows={len(chunk)} IK failures={failures} "
+            f"tip={result.proprio[-1, 7:10].round(4).tolist() if result.proprio is not None else 'n/a'}"
+        )
+        if result.done:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended during {note}")
+        last_target = chunk[-1].astype(float)
+
+
+def move_to(target: np.ndarray, note: str, max_step_m: float = 0.005) -> None:
+    """Move at a safe speed from the previous target to one new pose."""
+    global last_target
+    end = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - last_target[:3]))
+    count = max(1, int(math.ceil(distance / max_step_m)))
+    rows = np.linspace(last_target, end, count + 1, dtype=np.float32)[1:]
+    submit_rows(rows, note)
+
+
+def hold_at(target: np.ndarray, count: int, note: str) -> None:
+    submit_rows(np.repeat(np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float32)[None, :], count, axis=0), note)
+
+
+def calibrate_practice() -> None:
+    """Ink once and probe five pressures plus two fine pressures off-task."""
+    move_to(pose(-0.100, 0.150, 0.045), "approach ink stone")
+    move_to(pose(-0.100, 0.150, 0.024), "dip brush")
+    hold_at(pose(-0.100, 0.150, 0.024), 16, "load brush in ink")
+    move_to(pose(-0.100, 0.150, 0.050), "withdraw from ink")
+
+    for x, z in [(-0.020, 0.018), (-0.043, 0.014), (-0.066, 0.010), (-0.090, 0.006), (-0.115, 0.002)]:
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.160, 0.045), "practice reposition")
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.160, z), "practice pressure")
+        hold_at(pose(x, -0.160, z), 5, "practice contact")
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.315, z), "practice line")
+        hold_at(pose(x, -0.315, z), 5, "practice endpoint")
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.315, 0.045), "practice lift")
+
+    for x, z in [(-0.140, 0.019), (-0.175, 0.0195)]:
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.145, 0.045), "fine practice reposition")
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.145, z), "fine practice pressure")
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.225, z), "fine practice line")
+        move_to(pose(x, -0.225, 0.045), "fine practice lift")
+    move_to(pose(-0.200, -0.250, 0.160), "clear practice camera")
+
+
+def skeletonize(mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Zhang-Suen thinning, preserving the target mask's stroke topology."""
+    skel = mask.copy().astype(bool)
+    while True:
+        removed = 0
+        for phase in (0, 1):
+            p = np.pad(skel, 1)
+            nbs = np.stack(
+                [
+                    p[:-2, 1:-1],
+                    p[:-2, 2:],
+                    p[1:-1, 2:],
+                    p[2:, 2:],
+                    p[2:, 1:-1],
+                    p[2:, :-2],
+                    p[1:-1, :-2],
+                    p[:-2, :-2],
+                ]
+            )
+            count = nbs.sum(axis=0)
+            transitions = sum((~nbs[j] & nbs[(j + 1) % 8]) for j in range(8))
+            if phase == 0:
+                c1 = nbs[0] & nbs[2] & nbs[4]
+                c2 = nbs[2] & nbs[4] & nbs[6]
+            else:
+                c1 = nbs[0] & nbs[2] & nbs[6]
+                c2 = nbs[0] & nbs[4] & nbs[6]
+            erase = skel & (count >= 2) & (count <= 6) & (transitions == 1) & ~c1 & ~c2
+            removed += int(erase.sum())
+            skel[erase] = False
+        if removed == 0:
+            return skel
+
+
+def graph_route(skel_component: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
+    """Trace a component's longest medial route and visit any extra branches."""
+    ys, xs = np.where(skel_component)
+    lookup = {(int(y), int(x)): i for i, (y, x) in enumerate(zip(ys, xs))}
+    rows, cols, weights = [], [], []
+    for i, (y, x) in enumerate(zip(ys, xs)):
+        for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
+            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
+                if dy == 0 and dx == 0:
+                    continue
+                j = lookup.get((int(y + dy), int(x + dx)))
+                if j is not None:
+                    rows.append(i)
+                    cols.append(j)
+                    weights.append(math.sqrt(2.0) if dy and dx else 1.0)
+    graph = coo_matrix((weights, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(xs), len(xs))).tocsr()
+    degree = np.diff(graph.indptr)
+    leaves = np.where(degree == 1)[0]
+    if len(leaves) < 2:
+        raise RuntimeError("target component did not produce two skeleton endpoints")
+    dist, pred = dijkstra(graph, directed=False, indices=leaves, return_predecessors=True)
+
+    best = (-1.0, None, None)
+    for i in range(len(leaves)):
+        for j in range(i + 1, len(leaves)):
+            d = float(dist[i, leaves[j]])
+            if d > best[0]:
+                best = (d, i, j)
+    _, source_i, dest_i = best
+    source, dest = int(leaves[source_i]), int(leaves[dest_i])
+    route = [dest]
+    node = dest
+    while node != source:
+        node = int(pred[source_i, node])
+        if node < 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("failed to recover a target skeleton route")
+        route.append(node)
+    route.reverse()
+
+    # A target component can fork. Visit every remaining leaf from the closest
+    # backbone point and retrace that branch while keeping one paper contact.
+    extras = [int(e) for e in leaves if int(e) not in (source, dest)]
+    for leaf in extras:
+        branch_dist, branch_pred = dijkstra(graph, directed=False, indices=leaf, return_predecessors=True)
+        junction = min(route, key=lambda k: float(branch_dist[k]))
+        junction_pos = route.index(junction)
+        branch = [junction]
+        node = junction
+        while node != leaf:
+            node = int(branch_pred[node])
+            if node < 0:
+                raise RuntimeError("failed to recover a target branch")
+            branch.append(node)
+        route = route[: junction_pos + 1] + branch[1:] + branch[-2::-1] + route[junction_pos + 1 :]
+
+    coords = np.stack([xs[route], ys[route]], axis=1).astype(float)
+    length_px = float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(coords, axis=0), axis=1).sum())
+    return coords, length_px
+
+
+def target_routes() -> tuple[list[np.ndarray], np.ndarray]:
+    image = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / "target.png").convert("L"))
+    mask = image < 80
+    radius = ndimage.distance_transform_edt(mask)
+    skel = skeletonize(mask)
+    labels, component_count = ndimage.label(skel, structure=np.ones((3, 3), dtype=bool))
+    routes = []
+    for label in range(1, component_count + 1):
+        component = labels == label
+        coords, length_px = graph_route(component)
+        print(f"target component {label}: {len(coords)} skeleton samples, {length_px:.1f} px route")
+        routes.append(coords)
+    if len(routes) != 3:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"expected three connected exemplar regions, found {len(routes)}")
+    # Draw the large enclosure first, then its isolated upper stroke and the left U.
+    return routes, radius
+
+
+def resample_route(coords: np.ndarray, radius_map: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return smooth world targets with pressure matched to local exemplar width."""
+    seg = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(coords, axis=0), axis=1)
+    arclen = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(seg)]
+    total_mm = arclen[-1] * PX_M * 1000.0
+    sample_count = max(2, int(math.ceil(total_mm / 0.0009)) + 1)
+    s = np.linspace(0.0, arclen[-1], sample_count)
+    u = np.interp(s, arclen, coords[:, 0])
+    v = np.interp(s, arclen, coords[:, 1])
+    rad = ndimage.map_coordinates(radius_map, [v, u], order=1, mode="nearest")
+    # Light spatial smoothing removes one-pixel skeleton stair-steps.
+    if len(u) > 7:
+        u[2:-2] = np.convolve(u, np.ones(5) / 5.0, mode="valid")
+        v[2:-2] = np.convolve(v, np.ones(5) / 5.0, mode="valid")
+        rad[2:-2] = np.convolve(rad, np.ones(5) / 5.0, mode="valid")
+
+    # Brush-width calibration from the practice sheet (desired diameter mm ->
+    # tip penetration mm). Fine samples extend the measured pressure curve.
+    widths_mm = np.asarray([0.4, 1.0, 2.7, 7.0, 11.5, 16.1, 19.0, 21.0, 22.0])
+    depths_mm = np.asarray([0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 6.0, 10.0, 14.0, 18.0, 20.0, 22.0])
+    width = 2.0 * rad * PX_M * 1000.0
+    depth = np.interp(width, widths_mm, depths_mm)
+    depth = np.clip(depth, 0.5, 22.0)
+
+    # Convert target image pixel centres into the main sheet world frame.
+    x = -0.100 + 0.1135925 - (v + 0.5) * PX_M
+    y = 0.1135925 - (u + 0.5) * PX_M
+    z = 0.020 - depth / 1000.0
+    points = np.column_stack((x, y, z))
+
+    # Pause briefly at intentional reversals to let the PD arm settle on the
+    # branch tip before retracing it. This keeps the turn inside the exemplar.
+    dense = []
+    for i, point in enumerate(points):
+        dense.append(point)
+        if 0 < i < len(points) - 1:
+            a = points[i, :2] - points[i - 1, :2]
+            b = points[i + 1, :2] - points[i, :2]
+            denom = np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b)
+            if denom > 1e-12 and float(np.dot(a, b) / denom) < -0.65:
+                dense.extend([point.copy(), point.copy(), point.copy()])
+    dense.extend([points[-1].copy(), points[-1].copy()])
+    dense = np.asarray(dense)
+    return np.column_stack((dense, np.repeat(Q[None, :], len(dense), axis=0))).astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def trace_main(routes: list[np.ndarray], radius_map: np.ndarray) -> None:
+    for stroke_number, route in enumerate(routes, start=1):
+        contact = resample_route(route, radius_map)
+        start = contact[0]
+        above = start.copy()
+        above[2] = 0.045
+        move_to(above, f"stroke {stroke_number}: approach above target")
+        move_to(start, f"stroke {stroke_number}: lower to target")
+        submit_rows(contact, f"main-sheet stroke {stroke_number}")

+        move_to(pose(-0.200, -0.250, 0.160), f"stroke {stroke_number}: clear sheet")
+        check = r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam", "practice_cam", "side_cam"), video="none")
+        action_id_local = action_id

+        print(
+            f"after stroke {stroke_number}: control_steps={check.meta.get('control_steps')} "
+            f"time_left={check.meta.get('time_left_s')} saved view (action {action_id_local})"
+        )
+
+
+practice = obs.last["practice_cam"]
+existing_ink = int(np.count_nonzero(np.min(practice, axis=2) < 70)) > 1000
+if not existing_ink:
+    print("practice sheet is blank; running the ink and pressure calibration")
+    calibrate_practice()

+    move_to(pose(-0.200, -0.250, 0.160), "clear practice camera")
+
